answer_text:
You can buy Korean skincare online from a mix of Korea-based retailers (best selection, sometimes longer shipping) and US/EU-based shops (faster shipping, often easier returns). Reliable options:

## Korea-based (large selection, frequent deals)
- **Olive Young Global** – huge selection, lots of sets; very popular for trending brands.  
  https://global.oliveyoung.com
- **YesStyle** – wide catalog, frequent promos; shipping time varies by item.  
  https://www.yesstyle.com
- **StyleKorean** – strong discounts and brand events; ships from Korea.  
  https://www.stylekorean.com
- **Jolse** – good sales and sample-heavy orders; ships from Korea.  
  https://jolse.com
- **Stylevana** – good prices; check “in stock/ships in 24h” to avoid delays.  
  https://www.stylevana.com

## US-based (faster shipping in the US)
- **Soko Glam** – curated selection; good for beginners.  
  https://sokoglam.com
- **Peach & Lily** – curated, well-known; often carries exclusives.  
  https://www.peachandlily.com
- **Credo (K-beauty clean-leaning picks)** – smaller but vetted.  
  https://credobeauty.com
- **Amazon (official brand storefronts only)** – convenient, but higher counterfeit risk if not careful.

## UK/EU options
- **Skinsider (UK)** – popular K-beauty retailer.  
  https://skinsider.co.uk
- **Notino (EU/UK)** – carries some Korean brands; selection varies by country.  
  https://www.notino.com

## Tips to avoid fakes / bad surprises
- Prefer **official brand sites** or **authorized retailers**.
- On marketplaces (Amazon/eBay), buy only if it’s **“Sold by” the brand or the retailer**, not a random third party.
- Check **shipping timelines** (some items are “backordered” even if listed).
- Watch for **return policies** and **customs/VAT** (especially for EU/UK).

If you tell me your country and what products you’re looking for (e.g., sunscreen, cleanser, acne, hyperpigmentation), I can suggest the best stores for shipping speed and a short starter cart.
